extension.summary: Shared install library for the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons
extension.description: Internal Python library used by the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons. It is not runnable on its own and does not appear on the home screen; it provides the shared add-on install, dependency-resolution and Kodi-integration machinery the Setup add-ons depend on.
Installs repositories and add-ons for a personal Kodi build.
extension.news: v1.3.2: Reliable skin activation — Setup now ACCEPTS Kodi's "Keep this skin?" confirmation when it switches to Estuary MOD V2, so the choice persists across the end-of-setup restart instead of reverting to stock Estuary. (v1.3.1: Adds three File-Manager sources — "special://home" (special://home), "special://kodi" (/storage/emulated/0/kodi/), and ".tony.7.bones" (https://tony7bones.github.io/). New sources de-dupe by name and path; and ANY existing source pointing at the repo URL — with or without a trailing slash, under any label — is renamed to ".tony.7.bones". (v1.3.0: one-shot also installs + activates the Estuary MOD V2 skin and the MOD V2+ patch auto-applies via its service.)

extension.summary: Lean enhancements for Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: A small, non-destructive set of enhancements for skin.estuary.modv2 (Estuary MOD V2), built fresh against the Omega release. Reorders the gear Settings menu so Skin Settings sits above Media sources, and adds a dedicated "Tony.7.Bones MOD V2+" Skin Settings category that is home to our tweaks. The System Info overlay is hidden by default (toggle renamed "Disable System Info overlay"), the top-bar weather icons default to the Outline HD set (resource.images.weathericons.outline-hd), and the clock and navigation wordmark each have a per-item toggle that defaults to the stock look. The category also carries in-tab Apply and Restore buttons. Run after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Apply and Restore are both available — original files are backed up once and never overwritten, and Restore reverts every change cleanly.
extension.news: v1.4.6: Home menu now deploys the exact saved layout verbatim — the six-item trim, Movies/TV shows open POV, TV opens the Guide, the Favorites relabel, and the Movies List / TV Shows List widgets — and self-heals (re-deploys) if a skin update or a build race ever resets it. (v1.4.5: Home menu now reliably trims to six items even when Setup's live skin-switch raced script.skinshortcuts into caching the full stock menu — the service detects the un-trimmed menu and rebuilds it on the next boot. (v1.4.4: the auto-apply service now waits for the Home screen to actually render (not just for the skin to be set) before patching, fixing the occasional blank/unfinished home after a restart. (v1.4.3: new V2+ icon; channel numbers off. v1.4.2: TV opens the Guide, Favourites→Favorites, six home widgets hidden.)
